_metadata.description: Where each cation radius in shannon_radii.json that is not Shannon's (1976) ionic radius at its CN comes from, and what #69 changed. Every other cation entry is one of Shannon's ionic radii at that CN; tools/audit_radii.py checks both.
_metadata.rule: Agreed 25 Nov 2026 (#69): where Shannon lists the ion at the CN, his ionic radius; where he lists the ion but not that CN, a straight line in CN between his nearest CNs either side; outside his range, the entry is removed and Eir borrows his nearest CN; ions he does not list are removed, except Sn(2+), which NRM chose to derive from Gagne's measurements: at every CN Gagne measured Sn(2+)-O, his mean bond length less the O(2-) radius the file holds at the CN Eir looks it up at. Every CN he lists for an ion the file holds is in the file. Where a value had to be chosen among several of his at one CN, the plain coordination over square-planar or pyramidal, and high spin over low; an entry that already held one of his values kept it: Co(3+) and Ni(3+) at CN 6 keep his low-spin radii, 0.545 and 0.56 A (for Co(3+), whose mean Gagne measured, the low-spin sum misses it by 1.9% and the high-spin sum by 5.4%).
